adapter_config_invalid: The value of {field} is not valid for this adapter
adapter_config_unknown_field: This adapter has no field called {field}
api_key_invalid: The API key is wrong or has been revoked
api_key_not_allowed: API keys can only be managed after logging in
api_key_read_only: This API key is read only
arr_hook_invalid: Webhook event is not valid JSON
arr_hook_unauthorized: Missing or wrong webhook password for this instance
auth_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth_setup_code_invalid: Wrong setup code: copy it from the container log (it changes at every restart until the account exists)
auth_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong attempts: try again in {seconds} seconds
client_cannot_see_path: The client cannot see {path}: it sees only {folder} (as {client_root}). Pick a folder inside it, or change the client mapping.
client_mapping_needs_client_root: Also set how the client sees that folder.
client_root_not_absolute: How the client sees the folder must be an absolute path, e.g. /downloads (not {path})
cross_site_request: Request refused: it came from another website
disk_root_nested: {path} is inside disk {other} (or contains it): its files would be counted twice
disk_root_path_conflict: A disk with root_path {path} already exists.
disk_root_path_not_a_directory: root_path is not a reachable folder: {path}
disk_root_path_outside_scan_root: The disk must be in one of the mounted folders ({scan_root})
folder_already_added: '{path}' is already one of this disk's folders.
folder_is_disk_root: Choose a folder inside the disk, not the whole disk.
folder_not_found: The folder '{path}' does not exist on this disk.
folder_not_in_seeding: {path} is not inside a seeding folder: torrents seeded there would not be linked to anything
folder_other_filesystem: '{path}' is on another filesystem: hardlinks can't reach it from this disk. Add it as a disk of its own.
folder_overlaps: '{path}' overlaps '{other}' ({kind}): a folder can't contain another one or sit inside it.
instance_fields_required: Name, address and API key are required.
instance_incompatible: {label} runs {version}, not compatible with this instance ({local}).
instance_needs_https: {url} is a public address: use https://, so the API key does not travel in clear over the internet.
instance_response_too_large: The answer from {label} is too large.
instance_url_forbidden: {url} is not a destination Nazgarr calls.
media_item_not_found: This item is not in the library.
no_image_host_configured: No usable image host: enter the API key of at least one host in Settings › Upload › Images.
no_video_files: No video file found in the source.
notification_name_required: Give the notification service a name
notification_type_immutable: The type of a notification service cannot change: add a new one
removal_client_unavailable: The client of this torrent is not configured or is turned off.
removal_failed: The client did not remove the torrent: {error}
removal_not_confirmed: Confirm that the files will be deleted.
removal_not_in_not_imported: Torrent #{id} is not among the not imported ones: it cannot be removed from here.
removal_requirement_not_met: The tracker's seeding requirement is not met ({status}).
review_already_decided: Review {id} has already been decided: its client labels can no longer change
run_in_progress: A scan is in progress: try again when it has finished.
secret_required_for_new_host: The address points to another host: enter {fields} again, so they are never sent to a new server by mistake
setting_invalid_value: {key}: value not valid for this setting.
setting_protected: This setting is managed from its own page
setting_safety_for_api_key: API keys cannot change the safety settings: log in to change them
setting_secret_for_api_key: API keys cannot read or change secret settings
tracker_icon_not_available: This tracker has no usable icon.
tracker_upload_profile_conflict: Tracker {id} already has an upload profile.
upload_cross_device: A hardlink cannot cross filesystems: {path} is on another device than the folder for uploads.
upload_description_template_invalid: The description template cannot be used: {error}
upload_disk_missing: The disk of this upload no longer exists.
upload_dupe_appeared: Not sent: the same release showed up on the tracker in the meantime.
upload_dupe_no_download_link: The tracker didn't give a download link for this torrent.
upload_dupe_not_found: Torrent {id} is not among the dupe-check results.
upload_episode_order_unknown: The episode ordering {order} is not available for this series.
upload_job_split: This upload was split into episodes: carry on from their uploads.
upload_job_wrong_status: This can't be done while the upload is in status '{status}'.
upload_no_seed_folder: Disk {disk} has no seeding or uploads folder configured.
upload_no_trackers: Select at least one tracker with an upload profile.
upload_pack_duplicate_name: Two files are called {name}: inside the pack every file needs its own name.
upload_pack_mixed_unconfirmed: The episodes come from different releases ({fields}): confirm the mixed pack before uploading it.
upload_pack_not_a_video: {path} is not a video: pick the episodes, their subtitles come along on their own.
upload_pack_requires_folder: A pack needs a folder as its source, not a single file.
upload_pack_too_few_files: A pack needs at least two videos.
upload_pack_too_many_files: A pack can hold at most {max} videos.
upload_reseed_missing_video: The tracker's torrent has a video Nazgarr can't find locally: {path}
upload_reseed_needs_identical: {tracker}: a reseed needs an identical release on the tracker.
upload_reseed_needs_verification: {tracker}: run the full hash check first, only a passed check allows a reseed
upload_reseed_torrent_changed: {tracker}: the .torrent on the tracker is not the one the full hash check verified, run the check again
upload_resume_nothing_left: Nothing to resume: the remaining trackers are already done.
upload_screenshots_failed: Could not make or upload the screenshots: {error}
upload_seed_files_missing: The files of this upload are no longer where the client should find them.
upload_seed_folder_missing: The folder for uploads does not exist: {path}
upload_seed_path_exists: A different file already exists at {path}.
upload_seed_retry_failed: Adding to the client failed again: {error}
upload_seed_retry_unavailable: Nothing to retry: this tracker's upload is already seeding, or was not published.
upload_source_has_symlinks: {path} contains symlinks: upload the real files, not links to them
upload_source_is_disk_root: Choose a file or a folder inside the disk, not the whole disk.
upload_source_missing: The source is no longer there: {path}
upload_split_not_a_pack: Only a season pack from a folder can be split into episodes, at the match.
upload_target_busy: {tracker} is still '{status}': wait for it to finish.
upload_target_not_found: Tracker {id} is not part of this upload.
upload_tracker_not_available: Tracker {id} is disabled or has no upload profile.
upload_tracker_torrent_unavailable: Could not download the torrent back from the tracker, so it can't be seeded: add it to the client from the tracker's page.
upload_verify_in_progress: A full hash check is running: wait for it to finish.
watch_folder_not_found: The folder '{path}' does not exist on this disk.
watch_folder_overlaps: '{path}' can't be watched: it is the disk itself, or the media, torrent or upload folder (or contains one), so every import or download would start as a release. Use a dedicated subfolder, e.g. torrents/watch.
watch_folder_used_by_client: '{path}' can't be watched: a torrent client downloads or seeds there, so every download would start as a release. Use a dedicated folder.
webhook_url_invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
